title: Indian Atlas 046 · 1861
source_identification_note: Sheet 46. John Walker publication line reads Oct. 12th 1861. Full-sheet frame includes blank engraved areas in the north.
condition_note: Intact full-sheet scan, central fold and largely blank northern area. Graticule continues across blank paper.

affine_initialization.reason: Full sheet has three rows of labelled crossings, seeded directly on preview.

seed_provenance: Independent readings at 2200-pixel preview width. Fit/check assignments fixed before measurement. Source windows will be checked at native resolution.
longitude_correction_basis: Working two-step adjustment of −69 and −147.18 arcseconds.
crop_review_note: The inner frame bows between corners, especially along the southern margin. The crop follows the two measured frame rules with a six-pixel inset. All four original edge strips and corner enlargements were checked against the crop.
quality_note: The historical projection with an affine fit gives 11.74 arcseconds RMS on withheld printed coordinates. Interior meridian checks show appreciable longitude variation across this full sheet.
